scientific_integrity: A constructive finite-level inequality and sharp asymptotic saturation are proved by conditional variance and a finite-state Poisson corrector. Publication priority has not been independently certified. Source fixed-time semi-Markov bound and optimal weights are acknowledged; the first-passage analogue is explicitly labeled a hypothesis there.
scientific_limitations: Finite irreducible embedded chain; independent edge-conditioned positive holding times with finite second moments; renewal-epoch initialization; positive stationary drift of the marked current. The finite correction is independent of current weights but may depend on the chain and waiting-time laws. No stationary-age, infinite-state or zero-drift extension is claimed.
title: A sharp finite-threshold first-passage uncertainty law for semi-Markov clocks
